hints.title: Positional Value Parsing
hints.text: Parse the input numeral into a standard base ten integer by accumulating powers of the origin radix.

hints.title: Successive Modulo Division
hints.text: Extract target digits by repeated modulo operations with the destination radix.

hints.title: Reverse Sequence Assembly
hints.text: Reverse the collected remainders mapped to their corresponding alphanumeric glyphs.

hints.title: Reference Implementation

variables: L: length of input string representation
complexity.notes: Linear conversion between arbitrary positional radix systems up to base 36.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Manual base conversions without intermediate integers require complex polynomial division.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Alphanumeric character array allows constant time digit symbol mapping.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Demonstrate positional parsing and successive modulo arithmetic cleanly.
